channel.title: Wildcard Watch: MikroTik
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving MikroTik, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Keep patched: MikroTik RouterOS: 2 flaws exploited together
item.description:
MikroTik RouterOS: Authentication bypass · internet-facing · exploited from day 0 · fix: 7.24.2, 7.23.4, 6.49.21

First step: Update MikroTik RouterOS to the fixed version for your release line (for example 7.24.2, 7.23.4 or 6.49.21).

MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacker to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation. CISA lists 1 more flaw in MikroTik RouterOS as exploited on the same day (CVE-2026-67277).

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-67277, CVE-2026-86060

item.title: Keep patched: Mikrotik RouterOS: SSH user impersonation possible in Mikrotik RouterOS
item.description:
Mikrotik RouterOS: Spoofing · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited from day 0 · fix: 7.24.2, 7.23.4

First step: Update Mikrotik RouterOS to 7.24.2 or 7.23.4 or later.

RouterOS does not compare the complete RSA public key when matching an SSH authentication request to an authorized user key, checking the key type and modulus but omitting the exponent.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-67276
